(canon.py lines 31 and 33); awaited set_location / set_world_clock via asyncio.to_thread (canon.py lines 35-37); and the awaited asyncio.gather running _apply_threads, _apply_clocks, and _apply_participants (canon.py lines 74-78).
contracts.declared_mechanism: LangGraph guard node continuity_checker (make_continuity_checker) registered as a mandatory hop between planner and commit: graph.add_edge("dm_planner", "continuity_checker") plus graph.add_conditional_edges("continuity_checker", after_continuity, ["dm_planner", "roll_announcer"]), where after_continuity routes back to dm_planner while continuity_notes are set and plan_attempts < MAX_PLAN_ATTEMPTS (2). In-node layers: (a) deterministic cast repair via _drop_unknown_cast, which drops unknown-NPC directives surgically and returns repair notes if the plan is gutted; (b) fail-secure run_classifier (exception or None structured result returns None, never fabricates a classification) with one in-node retry; (c) double classifier failure emits rejection notes ('do not assume the plan is safe') instead of approving by silence; (d) an approved verdict clears continuity_notes and releases the plan to roll_announcer and the canon path.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A continuity-violating or classifier-unverifiable plan advancing past continuity_checker into the scene pipeline and canon_manager, specifically: (1) a plan carrying responding_npcs directives whose names are neither in ctx.conversation.characters nor in plan.npcs_to_introduce; (2) a plan the dm-continuity-check classifier returns as not approved / with issues; (3) a plan whose classifier run returns None twice (approval must never be invented on classifier failure); any of these being applied by canon_manager's writes to world events, secrets, location/world clock, quest threads, faction clocks, or participant state.
pending_binding_information: Where plan_attempts is incremented and whether state.continuity_notes survives the dm_planner repair hop - this determines whether the proceed-anyway branch (classifiers.py 91) suppresses re-checking of second-pass plans.

contracts.protected_operation: canon_manager's plan-driven deterministic Postgres writes: WorldEvent.add_items, DMSecret.add_items, set_location, set_world_clock, apply_thread_update, advance_faction_clock, and apply_participant_state_update.
contracts.protected_resource: Campaign world state persisted in Postgres for ctx.campaign_id: world events (WorldEvent), DM secret notes (DMSecret), location and world clock, quest threads, faction clocks, and participant state.
contracts.protection_obligation: Every DM plan produced by the dm_planner node must pass the continuity_checker gate before any plan-driven downstream effect executes: continuity-violating plans (directives for NPCs not in the scene, DM-secret leaks, player-agency/coherence violations) and plans whose continuity classifier fails to complete are returned to dm_planner for repair rather than forwarded, so only a cleared plan (or one whose bounded repair budget is exhausted) reaches the downstream narration path and canon_manager's deterministic Postgres world-state commits.
scope_limits: Repair budget is fail-open at exhaustion: when state.plan_attempts >= MAX_PLAN_ATTEMPTS (2) and continuity_notes persist, continuity_checker proceeds anyway and clears the notes (classifiers.py 91-93), and after_continuity forwards once the budget is spent even if notes were just produced; the gate never hard-fails a turn (classifiers.py 84-86), so fail-secure rejection holds only within the attempt budget.

The LLM continuity hop is skipped for low-risk plans lacking npcs_to_introduce, participant_state_updates, time_location_update, and secret_notes; only the deterministic cast check runs for those (classifiers.py 63-77 and 111-113).
A plan of None passes the gate with cleared notes (classifiers.py 89-90), but canon_manager no-ops without writing in that case (canon.py 25-26).
The gate covers only the dm_planner path; the OOC short-circuit (intent_router -> ooc_responder -> persist_messages, graph.py 125-126) bypasses continuity_checker but does not invoke canon_manager.
Downstream narration, npc_executor, roll_announcer, turn_epilogue, and persist_messages effects are not evaluated as protected commit points here; their node sources are not among the supplied views.
WorldEvent.add_items and DMSecret.add_items are dispatched via fire_and_forget without awaiting; their internal transaction/commit semantics lie outside the supplied source.
